name: V-Touchpad
description: Keeps the cursor steady and menus and drag-and-drop working while you use the V-Touchpad on-screen touchpad. GNOME hides the cursor and takes pointer focus away on every touchscreen event; while the pad is open, this keeps pointer focus and shows the cursor again right away. It also passes touches on the pad to V-Touchpad itself, so an app's open menu or drag cannot take them away: menus stay open and drags last until you let go.
